INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

2. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Creative Writing – Poetry.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

6. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.

----

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 7.3.1 Assessment of Writing – Narrative Composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
